title: Article III standing
summary: Standing asks whether the party invoking federal judicial power has the constitutionally required personal stake in the requested relief. The assigned discussion emphasizes concrete injury and its relationship to the challenged conduct and remedy.
notes: Real party in interest, class representation, diversity, and personal jurisdiction are distinct inquiries. TransUnion expressly reserves a separate question about the timing of every class member’s standing showing before certification.

sections.Meaning: Standing asks whether the party invoking federal judicial power has the constitutionally required personal stake in the requested relief. The assigned discussion emphasizes concrete injury and its relationship to the challenged conduct and remedy.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the plaintiff’s injury, the connection to the defendant’s conduct, and whether the requested judicial relief addresses that injury. In a damages class, apply TransUnion’s requirement to each person recovering individual damages.
